title: Speech to Text
description: Transcribes or translates an audio or video file with faster-whisper (OpenAI Whisper on CTranslate2) and returns the transcript, timed segments and ready-to-use .srt / .vtt subtitles. Runs on a CPU runtime with int8 models, and much faster on a GPU.
author: NZAP Labs

params.label: Audio or video file
params.description: Any format ffmpeg reads: mp3, wav, m4a, ogg, flac, mp4, mkv, webm…

params.label: Model
params.description: Bigger models are more accurate and slower.

params.label: Task
params.description: Translate turns speech in any language into English text.

params.label: Skip silence (voice activity detection)
params.description: Cuts out silence and music before transcribing, which avoids made-up text in quiet parts.

params.label: Short subtitle lines (word timings)
params.description: Times every word and builds subtitle lines of at most 42 characters. A little slower.
